create_mpmodel: create an MPModel dataclass to encode a mixed-integer linear programming model with variables and constraints
tighten_variable_bounds: tighten variable bounds in-place on a MIP model given variable names and their new lower and upper bounds
add_binary_invalid_cut: add a weighted binary invalid cut constraint to a MIP model to prune infeasible binary assignments
make_sub_mip: create a sub-MIP by deep-copying a model and tightening variable bounds from a sampling assignment
is_var_binary: check whether a MIP variable is binary with lower bound 0, upper bound 1, and integer type
